common_requirements: Source casting time, range, components, duration and all available invocation profiles remain per-entry requirements. Components are consumed only when source/common casting rules say so; priced nonconsumed items cannot use ordinary focus substitution.

Class acquisition, known/prepared grants, caster/source level, exact slot profile, action/Reaction entitlements, target typing, senses/cover, material/free-hand/focus policy and any long-cast/ritual interruption must be closed through SP-01/02/05; source classes do not prove acquisition or production support.

Damage/healing, actual integer rounding and defenses use pinned native Health/Calculation. CurrentHP, temporaryHP, LifeState, resource state, Asset placement, Effects, lore/knowledge/disclosure and Procedure budgets retain their actual owners.

Reactions, choices, long-lived work and target-local end/repeat triggers have exact causal occurrence identities, fixed RNG, source/context references, complete dependency enrollment, lawful owner atomicity, retry and cold-recovery proof. No accepted consequence may reroll/reapply because a later presentation fails.

Every referenced creature form, summon stat block/action, condition, feat/feature prerequisite, item/component profile, sense, plane/travel and named spell interaction is a transitive required support dependency. Eligible-set proof is separate from a list of familiar examples.

Supported set equality is source requirement -> exact mode/definition -> actual typed consumer -> dependency/machine admission -> production/conformance proof. This pass proves only source-to-candidate routing with qualifications; all machine IDs and executable recipes remain unmaterialized here.

Large legitimate sets stay complete; chunk size cannot cap targets, skip mandatory consequences or change RNG distribution. Required world facts may use authorized bounded adjudication; deterministic formulas and missing installed rule content may not be supplied by an LLM guess.

candidate_specificity_or_omission_obliga.requirement: Teleport has potentially repeated Mishap damage plus d100 draws before arrival. A budget may suspend, not cap outcomes or convert required repeat into failure; generic arbitrary recipe loops remain forbidden.

All modes were read: duplication; object; instant health; permanent resistance; 8h spell/other-magic immunity; eligible feat replacement including features' dependency graph; recent-round Roll Redo with Advantage/Disadvantage and original/new selection; open Reshape Reality; nonduplication stress, unpreventable per-spell-level damage, Strength3/2d4-day recovery and exact33percent permanent casting loss. Only Roll Redo contradicts current accepted Step-5.9/Step-3 immutable causal past/fixed retry. Do not convert it to ordinary retry or optional generic rollback. Routine modes need exact contracts, not repeated PO gate.

Stable Actor identity alone does not close concurrent original/host/projected scopes, separate HP/effects/gear, soul freedom/consent, exchange/control, original remains' revivability, cord-only severance, linked0HP/death/return or transfer. Define only these consumer-witnessed profiles and their native atomic/recovery dependencies, not a universal soul graph/service.

Caster-only extra turns and no time for others need exact Procedure/chronology bridges and causal early-end check; forward suspended animation/maturity/aging do not reopen accepted mutable-past law. Source instantaneous labels leave continuing work. Preserve caster distance from original cast location and no other-creature/other-worn-carried-object effects before continued isolated actions.

Natural-language observable/visual/audible/possession/task/ritual triggers must normalize to a finite accepted fact/predicate and indexed dependencies with rearm/end/replacement. Imprisonment's high-likelihood-within-decade GM judgment is not automatic10-year expiry. Programmed Illusion cooldown, Symbol movement break, Contingency component possession and four-family dispel are distinct native contracts.

Close every eligible source/stat block/action and retain exact per-spell fields, first-form temporaryHP versus newformHP, gear policy, anatomy/speech/casting grants, permanent conversion, no-memory object time, command/default/expiry, initiative placement and snapshot rules. Permanent creatures persist after control expiry; Simulacrum's forbidden rest and paid caster-rest repair differ; source-defined no-recursive-Simulacrum is real restriction.

Suppress versus terminate; duration still elapses; protected spell origins; cast-source level/location; target/no-effect outcomes; travel in/out; portal closure; spell/magic/item restrictions; exact Wish-information exception; failed-forcecage-exit wasted resources; Prismatic layer-specific antimagic/dispel/destruction; imprisonment9th-slot targeted dispel. A generic suppress-all-magic operation cannot discharge these distinctions.

Fire Storm says each Cube is contiguous with at least one other Cube, not expressly that all cubes form one connected component. Do not strengthen this from an inventory shorthand. Wall of Ice's each-panel-neighbor predicate and Guards and Wards' explicitly contiguous roster are different declarations. Spatial accepted-fact contracts preserve these exact predicates.

Instantaneous damage may leave maximum-HP reduction/capability prohibition/Stun, unlike direct death. Actual dealt Necrotic damage drives Harm maximum reduction. Feast benefits start after consumption. Regenerate anatomy clock differs from turn healing. Resurrection rest penalty/caster tax, Wind Walk transition/end descent, numbered storm turns and wave height/damage/once-per-round phase state need exact native responders, not one generic periodic effect.

Persistent room identity/contents outlive doors; complete choices/expulsion; imported versus created contents; willing group/destination modes; exact names/rulers with no creature control; named object possession/information branch; plant traversal by anyone; six-month linked-object evidence; caster sanctuary preparation. No remote world scan, gameplay rules browse, silent content loss or prior-edition offensive Plane Shift.
